question: list the titles of films released in 1994
reference_sql: select title from films where release_year = 1994

question: which films have the highest rating?
reference_sql: select f.title, r.score from films f join ratings r on r.film_id = f.id order by r.score desc limit 10

which people are credited on more than five films?
reference_sql: select p.name, count(*) as film_count from credits c join people p on p.id = c.person_id group by p.name having count(*) > 5

question: delete every film released before 1950
reference_sql: select count(*) from films where release_year < 1950

question: list all films; drop table films
what are the ten longest films?
reference_sql: select title, runtime_minutes from films order by runtime_minutes desc limit 10

question: how many films were released per decade?
reference_sql: select (release_year / 10) * 10 as decade, count(*) from films group by decade order by decade
